description.value: You can spend your action to menace a chosen creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you, forcing a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier; while raging, double your proficiency bonus for this DC instead of adding it once). Failure leaves the creature frightened of you until the end of your next turn, and you can spend further actions on later turns to keep extending that fear by the same duration. The effect lapses early if the creature ends its turn out of your line of sight or more than 60 feet away. Anyone who succeeds on the save becomes immune to this feature for the next 24 hours.
